customManagers.description: Directory.Build.targets pins the implicit Microsoft.NET.ILLink.Tasks (KnownILLinkPack ILLinkPackVersion), so the lock files do not depend on the SDK patch. After a bump, regenerate every packages.lock.json (dotnet restore --force-evaluate).

The e2e workflow installs the Playwright OS dependencies with the npm CLI of the Microsoft.Playwright pin (build/Build.CI.cs reads Directory.Packages.props), so the generated e2e.yml moves in the same PR and VerifyWorkflows stays green.

packageRules.description: SPEC §20.2: automerge minor and patch updates of dev dependencies, only through platform automerge behind the required checks. The runtime dependencies of SPEC §3 (Microsoft.Extensions.*, Microsoft.AspNetCore.*, R3) are excluded by pattern, so one a later story adds is never automerged; the test-only Microsoft.Extensions.* packages are excluded with them.

Fallout pins the actions of the generated workflows (only release.yml, pr-title.yml and docs.yml are hand-written); an edit there fails VerifyWorkflows. They move with a Fallout bump and a regeneration.
S-1 (R-PKG-3, ADR-0003): Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp 5.0.0 is the Roslyn of SDK 10.0.100, the generator floor, and global.json pins that SDK. Never update either.
SPEC §3: R3 stays on 1.x (1.3.x pin, packed as R3 >= 1.3.x).

test/BannedSymbols.covered.txt lists CsCheck.Check overloads by exact documentation ID, and BannedApiAnalyzers ignores an ID that no longer resolves and cannot ban an overload it is not given. Before merging, run `dotnet run test/banned-ids.cs -- check`: it fails on a listed ID that no longer resolves and on a generated overload missing from the list (a bump that adds a threads overload). Paste the cscheck group printed by `dotnet run test/banned-ids.cs` into the list, then update test/Shared/Property.cs.

These analyzers load into the repo's own compiler, and the repo must build on SDK 10.0.100 (Roslyn 5.0.0; global.json, M0-01): a release built against a newer Roslyn fails every 10.0.100 build with CS9057, which CI on a newer SDK (rollForward latestFeature) does not see. Before merging, build the repo with exactly SDK 10.0.100 (the spikes/S-1-roslyn-floor/README.md side-by-side install and a global.json with rollForward disable).
The ILLink pack stays on the 10.0 line of the net10.0 target (Directory.Build.targets).
